identity.description: lse runs Linux Smart Enumeration to surface privesc and lateral opportunities. The tool is delivered through the Cortex POV payload shelf (sha256-pinned ccb6a164caa590bc…, staged to /tmp/lse.sh) rather than an ad-hoc internet download, so it survives default-deny egress and the absent detection is never a manufactured false negative. Cortex should detect the execution of lse and its artifacts.

payload.code:
# MATURE: lse deployed via adapter_ref TOOL-LSE + payload shelf.
[ -s /tmp/lse.sh ] || { echo '[FATAL] PAYLOAD_NOT_STAGED_ON_TARGET:/tmp/lse.sh — TTP did NOT run; absent detections are NOT a Cortex miss' >&2; exit 1; }
sha256sum /tmp/lse.sh
/tmp/lse.sh -l1

expected_artifacts.description: lse executed by a service account.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Lse Executed by a Service Account on the Endpoint
biocs.description: A non-interactive service account runs lse — an offensive TOOL-LSE-wired tool not part of normal operations on this host.
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter actor_process_image_path contains "/tmp/lse.sh" or action_process_command_line contains "lse"
| comp count() as runs by agent_hostname, actor_effective_username
| filter runs >= 1

abiocs.name: First-Seen Execution of lse on This Host
abiocs.description: A host that has never run lse executes it shortly after it is staged/installed — the deploy-then-run chain of an offensive tool.
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_command_line contains "lse"
| comp count() as first_runs by agent_hostname
abiocs.causality_anchor: adapter deploy/stage of lse -> first execution by a service-account shell

xql_queries.name: Lse Execution Hunt
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_command_line contains "lse"
| fields agent_hostname, actor_effective_username, action_process_image_name, action_process_command_line

iocs.context: lse artifact path/name on the target.
